definitions.explanation: High, rugged mountain areas. Used as a formal or technical term for mountainous terrain, often in compound words related to mountaineering and geography.

examples.japanese: {山岳|さんがく}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{山岳|さんがく}⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出動|しゅつどう}→出動：28803_shutsudou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The mountain rescue team was dispatched.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{山岳|さんがく}⟦{信仰|しんこう}→信仰：03685_shinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧おり、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{御神体|ごしんたい}→御神体：23465_goshintai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Mountain worship in Japan has continued since ancient times, and many mountains are regarded as sacred objects.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, literary term for mountains. In everyday speech, ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ is more common, but {山岳|さんがく} appears frequently in compound words related to mountaineering, geography, and nature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {山岳|さんがく}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: mountainous region
- {山岳|さんがく}{部|ぶ}: mountaineering club
- {山岳|さんがく}⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧: mountain rescue
- {山岳|さんがく}⟦{信仰|しんこう}→信仰：03685_shinkou⟧: mountain worship
- {山岳|さんがく}⟦ガイド→ガイド：05116_gaido⟧: mountain guide
